name: weave_get_workflow
description: Reads a Weave workflow's graph. With only `workflowId`, returns the outline: nodes as `id  type  model  name  outputs=N  at=x,y`, then edges; with `nodeIds`, those nodes in full. An input in `connectedInputs` is taken; `expandableUpTo: N` also accepts `<base>_2`..`<base>_N`. A node in a group ends with `in=<groupId>`; a `custom_group` line's name is the group's label. `at=` and `position` are relative to a `parentId` group. `generations` are in display order. Graphic nodes (Blur, Crop, Compositor) store no output: set `renderOutputs` to render them, which takes seconds, so only when you need to see one. A render that is refused or busy comes back as a note: ask again later, not right away. View a file with `curl -fL --proto =https --proto-redir =https -o <file> -- '<url>'`.

workflowId.description: The id of the Weave workflow to read.

nodeIds.description: Ids from the outline to return in full, at most 5.

generationIds.description: Generation ids on the `nodeIds` nodes to return with their url or text.

renderOutputs.description: Render the `nodeIds` graphic nodes from the last save and return their outputs as URLs.
